outcome.answer: The matching paper is Fast and Geometrically Grounded Lorentz Neural Networks by Robert van der Klis and coauthors [1]. It presents a Lorentz-model hyperbolic neural network, argues that the current Lorentz linear layer has a scaling problem, and proposes a new distance-to-hyperplane-based Lorentz linear layer with faster propagation and hyperbolic geometry guarantees [1].
